description.value:
Frequency once per encounter

Traits Signal

The first time you begin a Broadcast in an encounter, your Encore pool starts at 1 rather than 0. This is in addition to the Encore you gain at the start of each of your turns, and it counts against your cap normally. Beginning a later Broadcast in the same encounter starts you at 0 as usual.

cinderfall.incomplete: SB1. No SpecialResource rule element exists for Encore, this class's own resource (defined only in prose in classes.the-signal.json's terms flag). SpecialResource can model a permanent resource pool (renew: false) per pf2e-source, so this is a real gap, not a schema limitation, but nothing in the corpus fills it -- no companion class-feature/ability/effect card holds it either.
